title: tripolium subulatum
intro: Tripolium subulatum, commonly known as sea lavender, is a flowering plant in the daisy family that grows in coastal areas and wetlands. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it useful for soothing skin irritations and protecting against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Tripolium subulatum include its ability to calm digestive issues, reduce anxiety, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
